I followed Tasha to inspect the smaller durian, then approached the shelf and agreed to buy two boxes of durian pizza for lunch, with Tasha retrieving them. We confirmed the purchase before moving on.

While walking, I asked Tasha about her sweet drink; after she showed me a juice bottle, we decided that one small bottle was sufficient, avoiding the larger size. Later, I clarified a previous shopping intent from "king crab" to "oil" with Violet and Tasha, noting corn oil might be inadequate.
